title: HtmlS
responsibility: Renders the native s element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlS.attributes
inputs.description: Native s attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlS.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native s element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlS
outputs.description: The actual native s element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
